mapper.insert: INSERT INTO individual_image (individual_id, image_path, shot_time, recognition_record_id, created_at) VALUES (#{individualId}, #{imagePath}, #{shotTime}, #{recognitionRecordId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, individual_id, image_path, shot_time, recognition_record_id, created_at FROM individual_image WHERE individual_id = #{individualId} ORDER BY shot_time ASC, created_at ASC
